description: Rank the values of one dimension (by: title, state, metro, city, company, seniority, employment_type or remote) by jobs, pay or another figure, over all jobs or inside one filter, such as which states pay Software Engineers the most (by=state, title=Software Engineer, sort=pay_median). Answers come from a daily snapshot of open US jobs and give their as_of date; for current job counts or the employers hiring right now, count_jobs is the live source. Cells with fewer than 30 jobs are left out. No account needed.

by.description: breakdown only: what to rank (title, state, metro, city, company, seniority, employment_type or remote; place means state).

employment_type.description: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship or per_diem (lookup and breakdown).

limit.description: breakdown rows or dimension values to return.

place.description: US (the default), a state code such as TX, a state name, a metro area such as "Austin-Round Rock-Georgetown, TX" or a city such as "Austin, TX" (cities and metros only for lookup, breakdown and negotiate).

remote.description: remote, hybrid or in_person (lookup and breakdown).

role.description: A standard job title such as "Registered Nurse" or "Software Engineer"; leave out for every job. Same as title.

seniority.description: intern, entry, senior, lead, manager, director or executive, read from the job title (lookup, breakdown, negotiate).

sort.description: breakdown only: jobs (the default), pay_median, pay_p75, pay_p90, share_with_pay, remote_share, new_7_days or new_30_days.

title.description: A standard job title; lookup, breakdown and negotiate match more than 6,000 titles. Same as role.

name: market_breakdown
title: Rank a job market dimension
